work.summary: Prevent stale OCR reviews after failures and replace internal recovery case-conversion warnings with accurate pinpoint review behavior.
completed: Added OCR run-generation invalidation across reset, retry, success, and failure UI paths.
Current failures explicitly clear previous review DOM and in-memory OCR candidate state.
Normalized recovery case-conversion warnings from structured rows instead of displaying a raw provider token.
caseCount=0 recovery rows no longer produce a case-conversion warning.
Unsafe case rows use the existing pinpoint quantity editor with a Japanese explanation.

coverage: legacy recovery_case_conversion_required is removed when all recovery caseCount values are zero
real case conversion need becomes a row-specific quantity check instead of a raw internal token
current OCR failure clears the previous review DOM
late success from an older OCR run cannot overwrite a newer failure state
zero-case recovery has no false quantity warning
real case conversion need shows Japanese row-level explanation and pinpoint edit

nextAction: Use FINAL.8 on the real device. A failed OCR run must not leave an older review visible, and recovery rows with caseCount 0 must not show a case-conversion warning.
